title: H9: Fast-wind loss weighting and matched SDO component ablations
question: Can modest emphasis on fast training cases improve the H8 model, and how much of its gain comes from solar features rather than ensemble weights?
hypothesis: Weighting observed >=500 km/s cases more strongly during fitting, optionally blended with unweighted forecasts, reduces training-CV fast500 RMSE by at least 2% beyond H8 with at most 1% overall degradation. Matched component ablations distinguish EUV lines, ESP bands and mixture weights.
method: Use exactly the H8 isolated training bundle, four original training folds, fitting offsets6-18, validation offsets6-19, same fitting-block date purge and source-fold masking. No original test/Fold5 evaluation. Fix learner pair to ridge alpha1000 and HGB150iterations,lr.05,leaves7,minleaf30,L2=10,seed2026; fix prediction mixture25%ridge/75%tree for EVERY component ablation. Feature groups:78wind columns; wind+18ESP features(three171/257/304channels,fourlags,mean/trend); wind+44line features(sixchannels,fourlags,mean/trend,eightlogratios); wind+all62EVEfeatures. Fit loss weights1,2,4 on training targets >=500km/s,weight1 otherwise. Per group:unweighted,weight2,weight4; plus .25/.50/.75 convex forecast mixtures between each weighted pair and its unweighted pair =9/group,36OOFforecasts. Require unweighted all-EVE forecasts reproduce frozenH8selected predictions to maxabs<=1e-8 before any H9 selection. Incumbent H8selected(81.30416655overall,130.28857933fast500). Eligible if fast500RMSE<=.98incumbent and overallRMSE<=1.01incumbent; choose minimum J=.5*MSEall/MSEinc+.5*MSEfast500/MSEfastinc,ties simpler; otherwiseretainH8. Same preregistered inclusive500primary/600secondary,observed-fast RMSE/MAE/bias,detectionconfusion/POD/FAR/FPR/CSI/TSS/HSS,paired persistenceMSESS/deltaRMSEandcoverage; windowweighted and fixed-mean duplicate sensitivity. No new thresholds or grids after inspection. Report all36 and matched weight1 feature ablations even if negative.
inputs: H8 development results and predictions are the only prior outcomes informing this hypothesis. Training archive SHA25626c35997cf19e46e3b83310f17a2a7af42f6ff9726c8727b59fb8cee94fa6d35; EVE feature SHA2568dd7514d63689ffe725bd08738a109184c1a99e02dba045ee1c4a66ae71f8d04. Public H8 artifacts in https://github.com/kahirhumibntwerag/windnet-low-cost-study/tree/a0f6757/results/continuation ; Python3.12.9,numpy2.3.1,scipy1.16.1,sklearn1.9.1. H8 selected mixture differs from its wind incumbent mixture; this motivates matched-weight ablations.
conditions: Original cumulative US$5 Runpod cap; prior study approxUS$.12 plus H8 cpu3c2vCPU approxUS$.01. Disposable RunpodCPU atUS$.06/hour plus temporary10GBstorage approx$.001/hour; retain only our volume between loops and delete after downloadedoutputs. OriginalFold5 absent; no further holdout exploration or holdout-driven choices. Retrospective EVE V8 calibration, no operational as-issued claim. Excluded366/1216 remain excluded. Paper deferred during improvement. Selected training CV results are exploratory and optimistic; no WindNet test superiority claim.
success_criteria: At least2% further fast500RMSE reduction with <=1% overallRMSE degradation against frozenH8selected on same pooled training-side CV. 600 metrics cannot determine support. Exact-H8 prediction reproduction prerequisite. Report matched-feature ablations independent of whether success criterion passes.
